Avoid: numbers over the dense clusters, next to other ornate gold finishes.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: almost nothing: the lace shapes need empty ground; maybe a very light grain on the black
Patterns to avoid: any line, grid or weave pattern: it turns the hairlines into noise; other ornate or floral patterns: they clash
Spec overlays that work: gloss variation to make the gold lines read as foil; a metallic spec on the gold only if it can follow the shapes
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
